title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W3 stale-bounce exhaustion gate broken for same-calendar-day corrections — mixed timestamp formats defeat the lexical compare
evidence: webhooks.gleam:297-305: "let genuine_failure = case row.matched_send_at {" / "" -> True" / "at ->" / "case row.corrected_at {" / "corrected ->" / "// ISO timestamps — lexical compare is chronological." / "string.compare(at, corrected) != order.Lt" — with find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql:35-42 "SELECT e->>'at' ... AS matched_send_at," / "COALESCE(rc.corrected_at::text, '') AS corrected_at," — at is the sweep's RFC3339 (sweep.gleam:178-181 now_iso() = timestamp.to_rfc3339(...), 'T' at char 10) while corrected_at::text is Postgres timestamptz text (' ' at char 10); 'T'(0x54) > ' '(0x20) so every same-day pair compares at > corrected regardless of the actual instants.
detail: A redelivered PRE-correction bounce on the same calendar day as the correction (the realistic minutes-later window) compares as 'genuine' and exhausts the corrected row: unreachable + fabricated referee_contact_invalid on a contact never re-tried. The pinned stale test only covers cross-day (send 2026-08-01 vs a later-day corrected_at), so it passes.
recommended_fix: Compare real instants (parse both to timestamps, or normalize formats in SQL, e.g. to_char/corrected_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' RFC3339) instead of lexical string order; add a same-day stale-bounce test.

title: Cross-row action race: a success response unconditionally clears the OTHER row's open edit-trio/confirm (typed referee PII lost silently)
evidence: client.gleam:3540-3547 (ApiReturnedRefcheckAction Ok branch): "Ok(_) -> {" / "let cleared =" / "Model(" / "..model," / "refcheck_edit: None," / "refcheck_confirm: None," / "refcheck_action_inflight: set.delete(" — the clearing is not scoped to the responding call_id, while inflight (reference_panel.gleam view_start_confirm/view_edit_trio) disables only the SAME row's buttons, so a second row's action can be in flight and its edit form open when the first response lands.
detail: Landlord fires an action on row A, then opens/typo-saves an edit-trio or confirm on row B while A is in flight; A's Ok response wipes B's form (typed values lost, no toast) even if B's own request later fails. The W8 id-guard only covers the toast/refetch, not the surface clearing.
recommended_fix: Scope the Ok-branch clearing to the responding call_id (clear refcheck_edit/refcheck_confirm only when their call_id matches), matching the Error branch's existing call_id-scoped re-enable.
